title: Yellow Spicy Mexican Poblanos Rajas Con Crema
description: A jammy, chewy Mexican dish featuring roasted poblanos, horseradish, and a creamy emulsion sauce, all without onions or garlic.
instructions: Roast the poblano peppers in a 400 degree oven for 30 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool, then peel off the skin and remove the seeds and stems.
Cut the roasted peppers into long, thin strips and set them aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine the heavy cream, mayonnaise, horseradish, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly add the pasta water and continue blending until the sauce is emulsified and thick.
In a large skillet, combine the roasted pepper strips and the creamy emulsion sauce, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and let cook for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the peppers are well coated.
Stir in the grated cheese until it is melted and well combined with the sauce and peppers.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, then transfer the mixture to a serving dish and top with chopped cilantro.
